name: Okayama Art Summit
funding: Okayama City, Okayama Prefecture and the Ishikawa Foundation lead the executive committee. Stripe International and Chugoku Bank are corporate partners. Foundation president Yasuharu Ishikawa directs the Summit.

name: Sapporo International Art Festival
funding: SIAF2027 is organised by the City of Sapporo's executive committee, supported by Japan's Agency for Cultural Affairs, the Kao Foundation and partners including Wacom.

name: Setouchi Triennale
funding: Executive committee led by Kagawa Prefecture and the Fukutake Foundation. Sponsors (Feb 2025): Japan Tobacco, Cosmo Oil, Okayama Gas, Shikoku Electric Power, Chari-Loto, Kawasaki Heavy Industries, Mitsui & Co.

name: Echigo-Tsumari Art Triennale
funding: 2024: JPY 360M committee budget. Paid for by Tokamachi/Tsunan, Agency for Cultural Affairs/JAC, tickets and furusato-nozei gifts.

name: 21_21 DESIGN SIGHT
funding: Run by the Issey Miyake Design Culture Foundation. October 2026 corporate partners: Mitsui Fudosan, Miyake Design Studio, Issey Miyake Inc and Shiseido as main partners, plus 20 other firms.

name: Mori Art Museum
funding: Corporate endowment from Mori Building Co., Shiseido, corporate sponsors.

name: Watari-um
funding: Private museum that opened in September 1990. It sells shop, art pass and support memberships.

name: Yamaguchi Center for Arts and Media (YCAM)
funding: FY2021 programme budget ¥305M: 88.7% Yamaguchi City, 3.3% Agency for Cultural Affairs grants. The 2026 show is funded by the same two.

name: Amman Design Week
funding: Founded 2016 by Queen Rania; organised with Greater Amman Municipality. 2016 sponsors: Al Manaseer Group, Zain, Aramex, Al Markaziya. 2026: Sukhtian Foundation backs the student exhibition.

name: Darat al Funun (The Khalid Shoman Foundation)
funding: Private non-profit founded in 1988 by artist Suha Shoman and run by the Khalid Shoman Foundation, set up by the Shoman family.

name: Makan Art Space
funding: Founded 2003; rentals and screenings, then grants from AFAC and SIDA.

name: A. Kasteyev State Museum of Arts
